text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A big victory! Taiki may have the edge in 
toughness, but when it comes to raw speed, 
I'm the winner! But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"1200 meters, shallow Japanese turf, and a 
hard track surface... Every single 
condition was in my favor. With this, I 
cannot truly claim to have bested the 
world champion."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take on Taiki in the Mile CS! 
It's a challenge against near-zero odds!
